# Online QR Code Scanner
> Free, fast, and 100% private client-side utilities for scanning and generating QR codes and barcodes.

## Scanner Tools
- [Online QR Code Scanner](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/qr-code-scanner): Scan any QR code instantly using your device's camera, by uploading an image, or by pasting an image directly from your clipboard.
- [Online Barcode Scanner](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/barcode-scanner): Scan standard 1D and 2D barcode formats (EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128, DataMatrix, etc.) directly in your browser.

## Generator Tools
- [QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/qr-code-generator): Create custom QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi networks, vCards, SMS, emails, WhatsApp messages, phone numbers, Bitcoin wallets, and plain text.
- [URL QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/url-qr-code-generator): Convert any website URL or link into a clean, downloadable QR code.
- [Wi-Fi QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/wifi-qr-code-generator): Create a QR code allowing guests to connect to your Wi-Fi network instantly without typing the password.
- [vCard QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/vcard-qr-code-generator): Share contact details (name, phone number, email, and website) via a scan-to-save contact QR code.
- [Email QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/email-qr-code-generator): Generate a QR code that automatically opens a pre-addressed email draft with subject and body.
- [Phone QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/phone-qr-code-generator): Create a QR code that dials a phone number directly when scanned.
- [SMS QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/sms-qr-code-generator): Create a QR code that pre-fills an SMS text message with a recipient and body.
- [WhatsApp QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/whatsapp-qr-code-generator): Generate a QR code that opens a WhatsApp chat with a custom pre-filled message.
- [Bitcoin QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/bitcoin-qr-code-generator): Generate BIP-21 compatible Bitcoin payment request QR codes with amounts and labels.
- [Text QR Code Generator](https://onlineqrcodescanner.com/tools/text-qr-code-generator): Encode plain text, serial numbers, coupons, or notes into a scannable QR code.

## Core Technical & Privacy Facts
- **100% Client-Side Processing**: No images, camera feeds, decoded results, or user inputs are sent to any server. All processing runs entirely inside the user's browser via JavaScript.
- **Offline Capability**: Once loaded, all scanning and generation logic works fully offline without requiring an active internet connection.
- **Advanced Decoding Engine**: Leverages browser-native hardware-accelerated decoding APIs when available, falling back to a robust software decoder for maximum compatibility (including light-on-dark codes).
- **Multi-Scale Image Scanning**: Automatically applies contrast enhancement and zoom scales to scan small, low-contrast, or partially damaged QR codes from uploaded images.
